title: Suppression config exists but its patterns match none of the contained files
mechanism: The artifact carries a .skillignore with patterns 'tmp/*' and '*.bak'. Neither pattern matches any entry of artifact_files (SKILL.md, scripts/run.sh), so `suppressed_contained` is empty and I-19 holds.
rationale: Negative control for I-19. It guards the false positive where the presence of a suppression config is itself treated as a violation, rather than the actual predicate (a pattern matching a contained file). The config is deliberately non-empty and non-trivial so the control exercises the matcher rather than the `suppression.is_none()` shortcut.
